top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a specific, originated invention, the magic-wavelength optical lattice clock, with a compact two-name credit (Katori, Ye), reproduced near 1e-18 in independent laboratories and already yielding new many-body and fundamental-physics results; it carries no maturity or reproducibility objection. P002 (twisted bilayer graphene with MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer) is the most exciting physics but its pairing mechanism is unsettled and experimental credit extends beyond one name, so it ranks second. A prize in a mature, uncontested area is preferable to no award.
